senses.gloss: f. (בטל; h. idleness, loss of time.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 105a:12">Keth. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>אגר ב׳</he> indemnity for loss of time.

<cite ref="Ketubot 105a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>קרנא ב׳ דמוכחא</he> (in the case of) Karna, the loss of time was ostensible (i.e. all knew that the fee he took for judging was needed to indemnify him for his loss of time).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 4:3:3">Y. Ned. IV, 38ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שכר בְּטֵילָן</he> (in h. phraseol.) indemnity for their loss of time.
